richiami.difetto: If the wheel chair lift sensors signal that the lift is not in the stowed position the service brakes apply.
richiami.modello: ESKER TOURING COACH , ESKER TOURING COACH
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to disconnect this interlock and restore the braking system to factory standard.  The lift is switched off after it has been used by means of an illuminated switch within reach of the driver that is standard fitment to this vehicle.
